description: Cheapest on-demand price for a GPU model at EU cloud providers (EUR per GPU-hour, ex-VAT, checked daily). Optional filters: EU-owned providers only, data-centre country, how many GPUs you need (drops offers sold only in bigger bundles), no US parent, EU data centre.

country.description: Data-centre country, ISO code or name (e.g. DE, France)

eu_data_centre.description: Only offers with an EU/EEA data centre

eu_owned_only.description: Only providers whose HQ and controlling owner are in the EU

gpu.description: GPU model, e.g. H100, H200, B200, A100, L40S, RTX PRO 6000

min_gpus.description: GPUs you need; offers whose smallest size is larger are excluded

name: cheapest_gpu
title: Cheapest EU price for a GPU
